snippet.title: Spike a Love Story 2022 - Developer Plays His Own Game Part 1: Story Mode
snippet.description: In which I play the Story Mode of my own game, the latest incarnation of Spike a Love Story. Currently in Early Access on Itch.io, I'll be posting the occasional update showing off the modes and all like that there!
